title: Goblin and Recipes: Match-3 Adventure
description:
Cook. Match. Discover.Join a cheerful goblin chef on a cozy culinary adventure where every completed chapter unlocks a real traditional Balkan recipe.

Match colorful ingredients, overcome obstacles, and fill your cookbook one delicious dish at a time.

Features50 unique puzzle levels

• Match ingredients to reach each level's score goal.

• Increasing difficulty with new obstacles and mechanics.

Unlock authentic Balkan recipes

• Complete chapters to discover real traditional recipes adapted with familiar measurements for cooks around the world.

• Learn to prepare dishes such as Uštipci, Stuffed Peppers, Sarma, Gibanica and more.

Whimsical fantasy presentation

• A charming goblin chef.

• Beautiful illustrated environments.

• Smooth animations and satisfying visual effects.

Special gameplay mechanics

• Frozen ingredients.

• Solid rocks.

• Spicy peppers.

• Explosive pepper shakers.

• Cascading chain reactions.

Play at your own pace

• Earn up to three stars on every level.

• Unlock Steam achievements.

• No ads, no microtransactions, and no energy system.

More Than Just a Match-3Every completed chapter adds a new page to your cookbook, complete with ingredients, preparation time, cooking instructions, serving suggestions, and a few words of goblin wisdom.

Whether you enjoy relaxing puzzle games or want to discover traditional Balkan cuisine, Goblin and Recipes: Match-3 Adventure offers a cozy experience with its own distinctive flavor.
description_short: A cozy fantasy Match-3 where every completed chapter unlocks a real traditional Balkan recipe. Cook, match, and fill your goblin cookbook.
